posts.author: Woeward
posts.body:
I'm using
Chrono Engine
for my game's battle system and would like to remove the NPC that allows you the option to change between Semi & Full Active Battle modes to instead place the option in the game menus. Originally I had wanted to place it under the Options button but opted to just use
Yanfly's Menu Manager
(with the
Core Engine
) to change the Common Event 1 template into my own common event called in the Menu. I copy/pasted the contents of the NPC's event and placed it into Common Event 1 hoping to call it using the template found on Menu 81 in the Manager; but instead I just ended up breaking the game when I open the Menu in-game.
Does anyone know what I'm missing when trying to use this plugin; or know if there's an easier way to call common events inside the in-game Menus as an Option?

posts.author: TobyYasha
posts.body:
Main bind shouldn't contain a 1 inside of it.
Meaning this:
JavaScript:
this.callCommonEvent1.bind(this)
Should look like this instead:
JavaScript:
this.callCommonEvent.bind(this)
If you want to change the common event that is called just change the "Ext" field with the number of the common event.

posts.author: TobyYasha
posts.body:
My bad seems i missed the fact that you need to have the name be between quotes.
So
Battle Mode
should be written as
"Battle Mode"
or
'Battle Mode'
